Since 0.1.3. The major version stays 0.

### Play
Y › Saves lists every save RomM has for that game, across slots, emulators, and devices, and one can be copied into another slot. The original stays (#313). A save that is waiting to upload, or an emulator that still needs its save folder, stays in view and asks to be set up (#311).

The Saves page wears Settings' chrome. A chip in the header says how the saves are doing, and A there sets them up or syncs while they need it. The top screen shows the game's art and the save you are on. A save names its emulator and its device the way they read (#319).

### Home
The launcher icon is one Afterglow strand drawing the clamshell. Covers sit on the bottom screen, and the top screen shows the one in focus (#310).

Scrolling the strip slides the background with the grid, on both screens (#322, #326). Turning the Thor slides that backdrop sideways, and tipping it slides the art up and down (#309).

Night Route is the default home track, a quiet loop with no beat. Lanternlight stays on the Track row. A board that had Lanternlight because it was the only track moves to Night Route once (#323).

PXPlay streams a PlayStation on both screens and wears its own Afterglow object. It files with the emulators, as Moonlight does. A board that had it under Android Apps moves it once (#325, #328).

aPS3e and EmuCoreX are drawn as Afterglow objects. The Play Store build of ARMSX2 wears that pillar too (#315).

Y on a tile leads with its verbs as round tiles, the first four that apply. A game shows Move, Add to, Art, and Saves. Edit home, on L1, lists the board: the open folder's Sort, Tidy while there are gaps, Recently played, New games on Home, and Hidden (#318, #321).

### Look
Emulators and library sources are tiles in Settings. An emulator opens its own page for the save folder and the rest of its setup. Library leads with RomM, each folder, each Moonlight computer, and Add (#316). Foldcade keeps one RomM server. Add a RomM server hides once one is saved (#314).

Closing a form or Licenses returns to the Settings row you left (#317). Picking a save folder from an emulator's page returns to that page (#320).

### Fixes
R1 follows the notices as they change. A opens a notice, and X dismisses it, the same way X removes in every menu. A held X removes the one notice you are on (#320, #327).

The release asset is `foldcade.apk`.

### Known issues
- The Thor hardware checklist is open. A green emulator run is not a Thor pass. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/43
- GameNative's own library is not imported. Foldcade reads exported `.steam` files only. It does not read GameNative's private database. https://github.com/predmore/foldcade/issues/100
